title: Speech synthesis for Walloon, an under-resourced minority language
description: A study of grapheme- and phoneme-based VITS systems for low-resource Walloon speech synthesis, including transfer learning from French and evaluation with native speakers.

title: CLSE: Cross-Linguistic Evidence from Sublexical Embeddings
description: Investigates the structure preserved in phoneme-, syllable-, and word-level embedding spaces across Spanish, English, and French using probing, clustering, and representational-similarity analyses.

title: PETER: Phonestheme Encoder from Transformer Embedding Representation
description: A multilingual Transformer-based encoder combining phonestheme tokens with word-level semantic and positional information.

title: Sistema de acionamento do freio de um carro autônomo
Controle da propulsão e o esterçamento de um Rover aplicado à agricultura de precisão
